mindfront_aksel_skin.author: Mindfront
mindfront_aksel_skin.description: This skin is made by a friend from an original MakeHuman skin and then I did the normal and specular map from one I have done erlier. The specular map and normal map have body hair but the skin texture have non but it gives the skin suitable ruffness and you can maybe use the specular map to extract the hair and add on the skin. In MakeHuman viewport the normal map looks bad. Edit 2018-11-04 Removed obsolete links

mindfront_skin_male_african_middleage.author: Mindfront
mindfront_skin_male_african_middleage.description: Tags: Male African Middleage. Male skin with textured body hair and genitals . I set the license to CC0 for maximum usage freedom. The normal map does not look correct in MakeHuman viewport but work in Blender. Of some reason it appears inverted with the 'None' topologie but correct with the 'Adult male genitalia' topologie. The original textures are 8192x8192 therefor some edges may be visible but I have tried to correct them. The normal map is quite strong and looks better when not set to 1 eg '0.7'. The preview image is how the skin looks direct after import in Blender Internal without specular map. For all audience I let the character wear swimming trunks. 2018-02-13 Updated the textures.
